reasoning: This is a Rust library (Cargo workspace) implementing a policy engine for the Praxis proxy. It is published to crates.io as 'praxis-policy' and designed to be consumed as a dependency ('praxis-policy = { version = "0.4", features = ["builtins"] }'). The workspace contains multiple internal crates (ppe, ppe-core, ppe-orchestration, ppe-apl-core, ppe-apl-cmf, ppe-apl-runtime, ppe-pdp-diff, builtins) plus reference plugin examples. There is no standalone binary or service entrypoint — it is a facade crate that re-exports engine types for host applications. The project explicitly notes 'this is a library' in its Cargo.toml comments (no panic=abort because it would take the host process down). It provides identity resolution, authorization (APL predicates, Cedar/CEL/OPA PDPs), credential delegation (RFC 8693), data control (redaction, session taint), out-of-band approval, and audit event emission — all as pluggable library APIs for the Praxis proxy to embed.
